answer: A payout is split so that 28% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The cipher schedule is applied in meadow and comet shows each instalment. Anyone thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4007 identities would post 1616 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
